::: {.module-outcomes}
## What you will be able to do

- Explain right-censoring and show how ignoring it biases a churn rate.
- Estimate and plot Kaplan-Meier retention curves by plan tier, with confidence bands.
- Fit a Cox proportional-hazards model and check that the true hazard ratios fall inside their 95% confidence intervals.
- Test the proportional-hazards assumption and say what to do when it fails.
- Compare Kaplan-Meier with the sBG model on the Fader-Hardie retention data and say which one can extrapolate.

**You leave with:**

- Kaplan-Meier curves by plan with 95% confidence bands
- A Cox model hazard-ratio table next to the true hazard ratios
- A restricted-mean-lifetime comparison that prices an onboarding intervention
:::
